title: C++: Feature Flags
description: Implement a feature flag system using a map of string to bool.

steps.title: Feature Flag System
steps.description: Create a FeatureFlags class with a map<string,bool>. Implement void enable(string name), void disable(string name), bool isEnabled(string name), and void listAll(). Test with three flags: dark_mode, beta_api, debug_logs.
hints: listAll: for (auto& [name, enabled] : flags) cout << name << ": " << (enabled ? "ON" : "OFF") << endl;
